name: portpilot
author: Abhinav Prakash
description: Map local dev ports to custom domains easily

scripts.build:linux: go env -w GOOS=linux && go env -w GOARCH=amd64 && go build -o bin/linux/hostpilot main.go && go env -u GOOS && go env -u GOARCH
scripts.build:mac: go env -w GOOS=darwin && go env -w GOARCH=amd64 && go build -o bin/mac/hostpilot main.go && go env -u GOOS && go env -u GOARCH
scripts.build:all: pnpm build:win && pnpm build:linux && pnpm build:mac
